basic_info.description: Stately and semi-detached three-bedroom, two-bath  home situated in a highly desirable Portola district location!  The formal entryway opens to a grand staircase leading to the formal dining room, a living room with a fireplace, two spacious bedrooms, a full bathroom, a large open kitchen area and an additional room all on the same level with 9ft ceilings and showered in glorious natural light. The lower level of the home has another bedroom, entertainment room, wet bar, and a full bathroom. There is a huge garage with plenty of room for parking, storage, laundry, and the possible potential for future expansion. The lower level of the home and the upper level both have direct access to the low maintenance and flat backyard that offers the winning combination of a gardener's paradise, a place to entertain, and a tranquil and peaceful space to relax.  Don't miss this special home that was owned by the same family for the last 60 years and is close to shopping, restaurants, cafes, playgrounds, public transportation, HWY 101/280 and more!
